frontend persistence.test.tsx::a_visitor_sees_the_saved_layout_while_the_owner_is_offline

evidence: frontend/src/features/profile/__tests__/RoomEntry.test.tsx::no_intro_post_component_renders_a_room_preview — every file under features/intro, features/event-feed and features/feed-thread is scanned for a profile-room import and for a room render
RoomEntry.test.tsx::the room feature exports nothing an intro post could embed
RoomEntry.test.tsx::the room screen is a route, not a panel of the profile

ui_widths.reason: 360/390/430 px browser captures need a running browser session against a live stack; this package ran the jsdom suite and typecheck. The layout is fluid (a 1:1 aspect-ratio stage, flex rows that wrap) and the CSS has no fixed-width breakpoint, but no pixel capture was taken. Recorded as NOT_RUN, not PASS.

limitations: The scene tests replace Phaser with a recording double (Phaser needs a real canvas and frame loop, which jsdom does not provide). The assertions cover ownership, release, draw order and texture filtering; Phaser's own rendering is not exercised here.
No browser was started for the 360/390/430 px captures; the visual acceptance for the room screen remains open.

The room route is registered in the shell router, but the shell's profile screen does not yet compose the RoomEntry section (that composition is the profile screen's owner). The entry component and its route are delivered and tested.
Room poster bytes are read through a direct fetch of the media path; the producer that serves that path belongs to the gateway/media package.
